work_items.title: Provide the `articles` storage schema
work_items.goal: Make the contracted article shape persistable in SQLite.
obligations: The column `description` has SQL type `TEXT` and does not allow NULL.
The column `price` has SQL type `DECIMAL` and does not allow NULL.

work_items.title: Provide GET /articles/{id}
work_items.goal: Return a stored article through the contracted GET endpoint.
obligations: A stored article is returned with status `200`.
The response contains exactly the fields `description`, `price`.
The response values equal the stored values.
The response conforms to the contracted SHACL shape.
